 CONCLUSION Our experiences demonstrate that although PPG has been most often reported in patients with IBD, it may occur in the absence of IBD. The gold doc is retrieved and shares almost the whole phrase, TG2 specific plasma cells markedly expanded within the duodenal mucosa, but crucially it says this happens in active celiac disease, meaning gluten exposed, not on a gluten free diet which is actually the treatment that resolves the lesion. So the gold doc does not support the gluten free diet condition in the claim, which is why the true label is NEI. The model matched on the heavy overlapping phrase about plasma cells accumulating in the duodenal mucosa and said SUPPORT, ignoring the key mismatch that the doc is about active disease while the claim is about starting a gluten free diet. Relevant evidence was present and the model over committed by missing the differing condition, so confident wrong, not contradictory, since the evidence does not actually argue for the claim, the model just over matched on the shared phrase.
